encounters.title: Boundary Stone, Year One
encounters.prompt: The founder's claim-stone, lettering worn by nine thousand weatherings. The line it draws is now a customs border.

encounters.title: The Caravan Master
encounters.prompt: A trader just paid your toll in salt and opinions. He wants the road kept as honest as his ledger.

choices.label: Make it official: feasts on schedule

encounters.title: Ash Pit and Brand-Mark
encounters.prompt: Cold ash, one burned field, a brand cut into the boundary oak. First tribute paid to fire, recorded in charcoal.

choices.label: Keep it secret within your family

encounters.title: Elder at the Fire Rock
encounters.prompt: The elder yields the fire-tender's staff and asks who answers for the tribe next winter. Succession happens at cave mouths now.

choices.label: Give the heir your unfinished tool
Declare the death bad luck and move camp

encounters.title: First Furrow Marker
encounters.prompt: Someone scratched a grain-count beside the marker: twelve years of the same plant, deliberately. Agriculture signed its first receipt.

choices.label: Build a platform over the shallows

encounters.title: The Stranger at the Ford
encounters.prompt: An unmarked traveler waits at the crossing with goods nobody trades here. The ford has never asked papers; the watch has.

choices.label: Take them in, make them earn it

encounters.title: Cache Shrine of Seeds
encounters.prompt: A hollow stone holds three generations of seed, sealed against famine. Faith with a germination date.

encounters.title: Herder on the Ridge
encounters.prompt: The herder counts the ridge grass twice a day and trusts no one who counts once. Move the herd wrong and the argument follows for years.

choices.label: Claim the best wall for the lineage
Paint over it with your own hand

encounters.title: Trail Cairn, Tin Road
encounters.prompt: Cairn at the fork where the coast route meets the high pass. Every tin bar that ever moved was weighed against this pile of rocks.

encounters.title: Tally Wall
encounters.prompt: Notches in the great wall count herds, floods, and favors owed. The oldest public record is arithmetic nobody can audit.

choices.label: Trade instead: tools for their berry grounds

encounters.title: The Dreaming Shaman
encounters.prompt: She says the future visited her and warned the lineage ends badly unless you stop doing something specific, specified only after payment. Half the cave is already nervous.

encounters.title: The Child Who Asks Why
encounters.prompt: Why is fire hot, why don't the stars fall, why is the answer always 'because.' The band must decide whether questions are a resource or a nuisance.

choices.label: Tell the child to ask the shaman

encounters.title: First Granary, Two Policies
encounters.prompt: The granary stands open for two arguments: store grain against famine, or distribute it against loyalty. Storage is power with a shelf life.

choices.label: Grain temple: store it, lend it

encounters.title: Irrigation Engineer of the Canal
encounters.prompt: The canal question is who digs and who drinks. Every irrigation project is a government under construction.

choices.label: Stay near the river, accept floods

encounters.title: Debt Tablet, First Issue
encounters.prompt: Clay records owe: grain borrowed, grain owed, interest invented in the margin. Debt arrived before writing and used it immediately.

encounters.title: Calendar Dispute Stone
encounters.prompt: Two calendars claim the flood date; the priests keep separate festival lists. Timekeeping is politics with almanacs.

encounters.title: Locust Verge, Post-Swarm
encounters.prompt: The swarm read the ledger and ate the surplus anyway. Reserves are theory until weather audits them.

choices.label: Sell to neighbors at famine prices

encounters.title: Walls Around the Yard
encounters.prompt: The yard got walls, then gates, then a gatekeeper. Surplus attracts geometry.

encounters.title: Ox-Yoke Test Field
encounters.prompt: Someone hitched the ox to the plow and the era's tempo changed overnight. Draft animals were the first engine.

choices.label: Tax the plough to feed the displaced

encounters.title: Water Rights Treaty Stone
encounters.prompt: Two villages carved sharing terms beside the same spring. Treaties are hydrology with signatures.

encounters.title: Census Counting House
encounters.prompt: Head by head, household by household: the first census counted taxpayers, not people. Enumeration is the quietest tax.

encounters.title: Temple Under Construction
encounters.prompt: The priest-king wants a temple; the labor corvée wants a word. Piety and payroll share a foundation trench.

choices.label: Redirect the tithe to the ditch

encounters.title: Seed Selection Plot, Season Forty
encounters.prompt: Decades of saving hardiest seed quietly rewrote the grass: double yield, wet-cardboard taste, roots raiders can't trample. Improvement chose flavor last.

choices.label: Commit fully to the new strain

encounters.title: The Elder Who Remembers Too Much
encounters.prompt: Three famines, two treaties, precisely who broke each. Writing arrives and there's a debate about which version gets carved; the elder has opinions about editing.

encounters.title: Tin Route Delegation
encounters.prompt: The delegation arrives to formalize the tin road: weights, escorts, tariffs, all negotiable except the tin. Bronze runs on logistics nobody sings about.

encounters.title: Debasement Assay Bench
encounters.prompt: The coin's silver thins a little each reign; expectations rise faster. Debased money is a loan from everyone, repaid in prices.

choices.label: Raise taxes to keep the silver

encounters.title: Law-Stele Draft Wall
encounters.prompt: Write the law down and it stops being whoever's angry today. Codification angers exactly one constituency: interpretation.

encounters.title: Road Builders' Camp, Mile Marker
encounters.prompt: Roads are arguments paved over: routing favors someone, every mile taxed by its existence. Engineering is politics that survives weather.

encounters.title: Palace Accounts Archive
encounters.prompt: Room after room of receipts: oil, wool, weapons, rations. The first state was a spreadsheet with guards.

encounters.title: The Philosopher's Invoice
encounters.prompt: He teaches virtue by the hour and bills accordingly; the invoice itemizes doubt. Education monetized, wisdom non-refundable.

encounters.title: Plague Quarantine Line, Trade Road
encounters.prompt: The plague moves the trade road's route, not the other way. Carantines: customs for biology.

encounters.title: Overextension Notice Board
encounters.prompt: Garrison costs exceed frontier revenue, posted officially. Empires die of geography; this board admits it in writing.

encounters.title: Library Copying Room
encounters.prompt: Every copy introduces errors; every error gets copied onward. Knowledge survived by reproducing, mutations included.

encounters.title: Temple Corporation Charter Stone
encounters.prompt: The first corporations begin badly: temple estates with shareholders, liability, and a god as figurehead. Limited liability had divine cover.

encounters.title: The General With Popular Support
encounters.prompt: He returns loved by the legions and the mob, in that order. History has a word for men like him and the word is not 'retired.'

choices.label: Co-opt: marry him into the lineage

encounters.title: Recoinage Mint, Third Attempt
encounters.prompt: Neighbors counterfeit your currency badly enough to undercut it. Recoinage costs a fortune; tolerance costs the standard.

encounters.title: Scriptorium Budget Slate
encounters.prompt: Copying a book costs a season; the abbot defends the slate line by line. Preservation is a budget line that never wins, barely funded, endlessly necessary.

encounters.title: Knowledge Decay, Routine
encounters.prompt: A roof leaked into the philosophy shelf; nobody was assigned to roofs. Civilization loss happens by staffing, not by fire.

choices.label: Let it rot; record the titles

encounters.title: The Hill Chief's Protection Offer
encounters.prompt: He offers protection at a rate that makes the bandits look like competitors. Government began as a protection racket with better catering.

encounters.title: Relic Economy Stall
encounters.prompt: Bone fragments of uncertain saints priced by proximity to the original. Inflation reached heaven first.

encounters.title: Winter Camp, Longship Haul-Out
encounters.prompt: They overwintered with axes and patience; the monastery kept better records of being robbed. The winter schedule included you.

choices.label: Hide the books, lose the gold

encounters.title: The Heresy File
encounters.prompt: Correct opinion catalogued, incorrect opinion catalogued harder. Doctrine is an editorial function with consequences.

encounters.title: Plague Parish Boundary Stone
encounters.prompt: The parish marked itself shut to hold the sickness in. Charity and quarantine carved the same stone.

encounters.title: The Lost Imperial Road
encounters.prompt: Perfect camber leading nowhere anyone still calls a destination. Infrastructure outlives the reason for it.

choices.label: Keep it secret, use it yourselves

encounters.title: Rededicated Well, Old Gods Under Paint
encounters.prompt: The holy well keeps its old offerings under new frescoes. Conversion negotiated in layers.

choices.label: Ignore both; collect taxes either way

encounters.title: Chronicle Continuation Desk
encounters.prompt: The Chronicle continues this season because someone showed up to write. Institutional memory is a shift that must be staffed.

choices.label: Begin honestly: 'here we lost the thread.'

encounters.title: The Wandering Scholar
encounters.prompt: He carries three manuscripts no library here owns and expects hospitality as payment. Knowledge travels lighter than cargo and charges more.

choices.label: Shelter him and copy his chest
Turn him in as a sorcerer

encounters.title: Harvest of Ashes
encounters.prompt: The burn took the barn and the seed store; the record notes both, evenly. Catastrophe filed under inventory.

choices.label: Break the seals; distribute church stores
Trade relics for grain from unburnt regions

encounters.title: Cathedral Foundation, Unfinished Aisle
encounters.prompt: The cornerstone is dated; the aisle isn't. Cathedrals were multi-generational capital projects with theology as the business plan.

encounters.title: Fulling Mill of the Cloth Guild
encounters.prompt: The trip-hammers dressed cloth until the guild decided who was allowed to be efficient. Labor-saving preceded labor law by a millennium.

choices.label: Keep the press running outside town

encounters.title: Guildmaster of the Weavers
encounters.prompt: He sets prices, apprenticeships, and gossip quotas with equal precision. The guild was a union, a cartel, and a family, all three, mostly.

choices.label: Counter: fund a public library in their name

encounters.title: Relic Casket, Authenticity Pending
encounters.prompt: The casket holds a bone of uncertain saint and certain revenue. Authentication was a marketing function.

encounters.title: Fair Court Toll Book
encounters.prompt: The fair's court judged disputes in three days and collected tolls in perpetuity. Fast justice, permanent fees.

choices.label: Let the marketplace of ideas brawl

encounters.title: Jester at the Feast Hall
encounters.prompt: The jester tells the truth hourly and gets paid for it structurally. Free speech survived on a payroll role.

encounters.title: Plague Village, Empty Row
encounters.prompt: One street, doors shut from outside, the well untouched. Quarantine worked; the village didn't get to enjoy it.

encounters.title: Charter Fair-Cross
encounters.prompt: The town's market rights, granted by charter, nailed to a cross of stone. Privilege got a monument and called it liberty.

choices.label: Buy the best pieces for the public collection

encounters.title: Money-Changer at the Log Bench
encounters.prompt: He converts eleven currencies on one bench and distrusts all of them equally. International finance started as a folding table.

encounters.title: Windmill on the Wold
encounters.prompt: The mill grinds grain, grudges, and occasionally the miller's rivals' grain. Energy independence, medieval edition.

encounters.title: Notary of the Bishop's Court
encounters.prompt: He records wills, debts, and the occasional heresy with identical pen pressure. Bureaucracy sanctified.

choices.label: Copy the fastest-moving texts first; abandon the rest

encounters.title: Drowned Field Chapel
encounters.prompt: The sea took the nave and left the tower. Coastal retreat with a spire as timestamp.

choices.label: Buy and burn the bad edition

encounters.title: Coffeehouse Share Board
encounters.prompt: Strangers buy pieces of one hull over cold coffee; the floor does work no exchange building exists to do yet. Joint stock invented itself between cups.

encounters.title: Charter Monopoly Grant
encounters.prompt: The crown grants exclusive rights to a sea lane: a tax collected by you instead of them, minus accountability. Bullion arrives warm and heavy.

encounters.title: Indenture Broker at the Wharf
encounters.prompt: He sells passage forward: their crossing paid, their labor sold by yours. The ledgers balance beautifully and something bleeds quietly.

choices.label: Grant nothing. No holds, no contracts.
Middle passage terms: shorter bonds, higher rates

encounters.title: Privateer Captain at the Tavern Table
encounters.prompt: His guns, your paper, rivals' cargo split by formula. Law, he explains with a bow, is mostly a flag you fly.

encounters.title: Plague Ship at Anchor, The Downs
encounters.prompt: Your own hull sits anchored with fever in the hold. The harbor wants her burned; the manifest wants otherwise.

choices.label: Quarantine. Feed the sick, lose the cargo.

encounters.title: Longitude Clockmaker, Claimant
encounters.prompt: A seawatch that tells west from south would end arithmetic deaths. She has steady hands, unsteady rent, and a proposal.

encounters.title: Company Fort, Court, and Seal
encounters.prompt: The trading house grew a fort, the fort a court, the court judges with seals. A proto-state that fits in a ledger provides law, roads, and precedents.

choices.label: Cap the forts, keep the counters
Hand the courts to the crown

encounters.title: Silver Fleet Price Board
encounters.prompt: Mountain silver arrives heavy and prices notice before anyone votes. Coin buys less each tide; the accountant twitches at 'monetary phenomenon.'

choices.label: Convert silver to land and hulls now
Lend against future cargoes at ruinous rates

encounters.title: Chart-Rock Wreck Site
encounters.prompt: A chart off by a hundred miles took two heirs and a grain hull onto rocks nobody drew. The surviving pilot insists the coast moved.

choices.label: Copy the old chart, add a footnote

encounters.title: Missionary or Factor
encounters.prompt: The heir abroad chooses equipment: bible or ledger. Both convert populations, just to different currencies; the schools keep adjacent books.

encounters.title: Blockade Season Notice
encounters.prompt: Enemy sails choke the lane and the calendar won't negotiate; miss the window and the season rots where it stands. Running costs hulls; sitting costs crews.

choices.label: Sit the season out, keep crews paid

encounters.title: The Ledger That Drowned
encounters.prompt: Double books, one per flag; the ship with the wrong one sank with the only auditor. Every entry now technically unverifiable, which is a kind of freedom.

encounters.title: Wreckers Claiming Salvage
encounters.prompt: They arrive promptly, help thoroughly, leave with everything, citing ancient custom. Custom was written by whoever owned the shore.

choices.label: Split salvaged cargo with the crews

encounters.title: Cousin-House Across the Ocean
encounters.prompt: It requests its own flag, its own books, permission to stop asking. Half the family calls it mutiny; the other half calls it diversification.

encounters.title: Pirate Articles on a Plank
encounters.prompt: Shares defined, injuries compensated, captains recallable, signed by every hand. The most democratic workplace charter afloat, hanged for it.

choices.label: Copy the articles for your navy

encounters.title: The Custodian of the Moving Shrine
encounters.prompt: She arrives with the portable shrine, the relic inside, and a route mapped three regimes ago. She asks which lord currently owns the concept of safekeeping.

choices.label: Give the Custodian a cabin and deference
Stow the relic with the cargo
Ask her to tell the brand's history aloud

encounters.title: The Rival Lineage's Envoy
encounters.prompt: The envoy compliments your granaries and leaves measuring tapes behind, visible on purpose. Competition introduced itself with flattery.

encounters.title: Petition Year Press Run
encounters.prompt: Rights rhetoric floods the presses at a copper-plate per sermon; the throne starts reading, which is worse than ignoring. Every petition cites an older petition.

encounters.title: Declaration, Curtains Drawn
encounters.prompt: A distant colony drafts its own legitimacy and the prose is embarrassingly good. Both sides ask which press you serve.

choices.label: Back the printers across the water

encounters.title: Constitutionalist Waving You to a Bench
encounters.prompt: The new order's rules get written while the army waits outside; property language drafted now governs centuries. Every clause costs somebody specific.

choices.label: Walk out on the slavery compromise

encounters.title: Terror Clause Posting
encounters.prompt: The revolution eats its writers, starting with those who proofed the menu. Moderation buys distrust from both wings.

choices.label: Leave the capital for the summer

encounters.title: Coronation Preparation Office
encounters.prompt: Ten years after burning thrones, the republic hands its favorite general a crown. Ideals versus order, packaged as ceremony.

encounters.title: Smuggler of the Continental Blockade
encounters.prompt: The empire closed a continent by decree; decrees move slower than sloops. Patriotism has excellent margins and a felony tail.

encounters.title: Rights of Persons Pamphlet Stall
encounters.prompt: The new code needs a definition of personhood and definitions compound into law. The pamphleteers want patrons; the debated want to be counted.

encounters.title: The Square's Ticket Machine
encounters.prompt: The machine runs on tickets now; attendance records make fine Chronicle entries — legible, dated, damning. Subscribing your name is cheap insurance or expensive courage.

choices.label: Buy the box seat, say nothing ever

encounters.title: War Bond Subscription Window
encounters.prompt: Finance the revolution at five percent and the new state's spine belongs to your ledger forever. Sovereign debt is immortality's uglier cousin.

encounters.title: Archive, Crated for Liberation
encounters.prompt: The liberating army ships your archive away 'for safekeeping.' File demands through channels, or hire someone who reads the channels.

choices.label: Let it go, buy the auction lots back

encounters.title: Census-Taker at the Conscription Debate
encounters.prompt: The nation-in-arms drafts every heir; clipboards arrive, the state learning birthdays. Volunteer, pay exemption, or equip a company instead.

choices.label: Equip a company instead of joining it

encounters.title: Code Drafters' Commission Desk
encounters.prompt: One rational legal code replaces three hundred customs and they want your commercial practice as template. Every clause borrowed becomes precedent.

choices.label: Insert one perfect clause for yourselves

encounters.title: Émigré Nobles Selling Family Silver
encounters.prompt: Exile with honor and no assets, or emigration with assets and no story. The émigré market crashes silver twice: sentimentally and literally.

encounters.title: Repainted Sign, New Flag
encounters.prompt: The house sign changes mid-decade; partners pick sides politely while repricing contracts. Flags are marketing for governments, credit ratings for houses.

encounters.title: Suffrage Audit Roll
encounters.prompt: The council decides who votes in the council; revolutions are awkward indoors. Franchise proposals circulate with anxious footnotes.

encounters.title: The Custodian at the Cathedral Door
encounters.prompt: She sleeps by the relic casket and lets the cathedral have the daylight. Safekeeping declined the promotion again.

encounters.title: The Rival's Factor
encounters.prompt: The factor buys your debt quietly, one bond at a time. Hostility upgraded to acquisition.

choices.label: Marry into the new nobility anyway

encounters.title: Press No. 1, Composing Room
encounters.prompt: The first press pulled sheets that multiplied arguments. Gutenberg's machine was a printing error for the control environment.

encounters.title: Ledger of the Antwerp Exchange
encounters.prompt: Bills of exchange circulate faster than the goods they represent. Finance discovered velocity before physics did.

encounters.title: Apprentice at the Type Case
encounters.prompt: The apprentice sets type at speed and absorbs heresy by osmosis. Skills spread faster than permissions.

encounters.title: Cartographer's Workshop Sign
encounters.prompt: Maps sold by the sheet, blanks included for conquering later. Terra nullius as a fill-in field.

encounters.title: Factor of the Trading Company
encounters.prompt: He represents shareholders who will never see the shore he profits from. The joint-stock company outsourced conscience to geography.

encounters.title: Navigators' Column
encounters.prompt: Dedicated to men who found latitudes and lost peoples. Monuments keep the flattering half.

choices.label: Skip the fair; poach exhibited engineers

encounters.title: Warehouse of Unsold Chintz
encounters.prompt: Bales rotted where protectionism won. Markets remember every ban better than the banned product.

encounters.title: Lens Grinder's Bench
encounters.prompt: Ground lenses made telescopes, microscopes, and eventually enemies of certainty. Optics was epistemology with overhead.

encounters.title: Insurance Ledger, Lloyd's Bench
encounters.prompt: Risk priced per voyage, premiums logged, reputations compounded. Insurance invented the statistics of hope.

choices.label: Stay out of financials; dig coal

encounters.title: Pamphleteer in the Print Alley
encounters.prompt: He sells sixpence revolutions and takes orders for the next one. Public opinion got a price list.

encounters.title: Lock-Gate Mechanism, Cut No. 3
encounters.prompt: The canal lock lifts barges eight feet and lowers freight costs further. Geography renegotiated clause by clause.

encounters.title: Natural Philosopher at the Air Pump
encounters.prompt: He drains the glass globe and watches the bird think about it. Science acquired a stage, a pump, and ethical review pending.

encounters.title: Steam Engine, Beam Type
encounters.prompt: The beam rises and falls like the era's pulse. Heat learned to do bookkeeping for muscle.

encounters.title: Rail Timetable Board
encounters.prompt: Departures fixed to the minute; the sun resigned as timekeeper. Standard time arrived as a scheduling constraint.

encounters.title: Navvy with the Navvies' Union Card
encounters.prompt: He digs the cutting that will employ his grandchildren and strike over who dug it. Labor built the future and billed for the privilege.

choices.label: Run R&D for the war department

encounters.title: Crystal Palace Glasshouse Footprint
encounters.prompt: Iron and glass prefabricated an empire's self-image. Spectacle shipped flat-pack.

encounters.title: Mill Town Cellar Dwelling
encounters.prompt: One room, two families, the river audible and unhoused. Industry's first invoice was paid in lungs.

encounters.title: Telegraph Key, Central Office
encounters.prompt: The key taps messages faster than horses can deny them. Distance surrendered first, then context.

choices.label: Adopt the org chart, ignore the strategy

encounters.title: Factory Inspector, Tired
encounters.prompt: He writes reports nobody funds enforcement for. Regulation arrived as literature with appendices.

encounters.title: Clearing House Settlement Desk
encounters.prompt: Banks net their chaos to a single balance daily. Panic got plumbing.

choices.label: Obsolesce by software later; hardware honest now

encounters.title: Inventor-Patentee at the Exhibition
encounters.prompt: He holds forty patents and no profits. Intellectual property protected everything except leverage.

encounters.title: Public Health Board Notice
encounters.prompt: Cholera mapped to the pump, the pump handle removed, the map kept. Evidence briefly won, locally.

encounters.title: Refrigeration Hold, First Voyage
encounters.prompt: Frozen mutton crossed the equator and changed diets permanently. Cold became a commodity.

encounters.title: Colonial Clerk at the Ledger Desk
encounters.prompt: He files the district's extraction in triplicate, neatly. Empire was paperwork with gunboats attached.

encounters.title: Conversion Order, Friday
encounters.prompt: Consumer lines become munitions by Monday; efficiency arrives wearing a uniform. The tractor plant learns tank tolerances, then waiting times.

encounters.title: Ration Book Counter
encounters.prompt: Children learn ounces before words; butter develops a black-market yield curve. The stamps were designed by advertising men.

choices.label: Open the estate gates to neighbors

encounters.title: Codebreaking Hut, Silent After
encounters.prompt: Brilliant misfits read the enemy's mail for room, board, and postwar quiet. The knowledge surge is enormous; the oath freezes it for decades.

choices.label: Route them to patent law instead

encounters.title: Cousins on Both Sides
encounters.prompt: The Chronicle must hide nothing and forgive everything; both cousins will read it. Every letter censored twice, love adjusted for operational security.

encounters.title: Home Front Shift Line, Twenty-Four Hours
encounters.prompt: Whoever stays behind runs the line around the clock: wages climb, hazards climb faster. The foreman's daughter holds the pace.

encounters.title: Bombing Choice Display Board
encounters.prompt: Staff officers present columns: plants or rail yards, precision measured in tonnage. Entropy doesn't check passports on the way down.

encounters.title: Parcel Exchange Coordinator
encounters.prompt: Small humanity at reasonable logistics rates: socks, tobacco, milk powder via neutral channels, priced in shipping tons the war needs.

encounters.title: Occupation Currency Crate
encounters.prompt: Coins stamped for occupied territories arrive with an instruction sheet. Spend them and the house inherits the stamp, filed forever.

encounters.title: Rocketry Scientists at the Checkpoint
encounters.prompt: Handed over with a checklist of the labs they built, handwriting meticulous, futures negotiable. Knowledge doubles; so do the strings attached.

encounters.title: Ceasefire Telegram, Three Seconds Late
encounters.prompt: Peace arrives timestamped while orders still travel; the last hour is documented and optional in hindsight. Choose what the Chronicle says happened.

choices.label: Halt at once, telegram or not

encounters.title: War Debt Write-off Floor
encounters.prompt: The creditor forgives nothing, the debtor prints everything; pick a side of the ledger to stand on. Creditors keep the moral high ground and less money.

encounters.title: Victory Parade Inventory
encounters.prompt: Triumph costs more than the war: banners, brass, a mile of bunting, crowds transported and photographed. Parades are infrastructure with applause.

choices.label: Skip the parade, fund the veterans

encounters.title: Liberation Footage Archive Reel
encounters.prompt: Dated, catalogued, undeniable footage enters the Chronicle; refusal to watch is also logged. There is no option that leaves you clean.

choices.label: Read it. Enter it. Teach it.

encounters.title: Radar Spin-Off Auction Floor
encounters.prompt: Wartime sensors find peacetime jobs absurdly well: ovens, air traffic, weather screens. The war's refund check, payable in convenience.

encounters.title: Peace Table Map, Pencil Lines
encounters.prompt: The map redraws in pencil before coffee; pick which border your grandchildren defend. Every line is somebody's kitchen.

encounters.title: The Custodian of the Wartime Archive
encounters.prompt: She seals the records for fifty years and dates the key. Safekeeping scheduled its own release.

choices.label: Ask her to keep carrying it
Copy the ledger first, then carry

encounters.title: The Rival Conglomerate's Spy
encounters.prompt: He photographs your process line and sends the exposure count. Industrial intelligence, analog and adequate.

encounters.title: The Censor's Evening Desk
encounters.prompt: V-mail reduces letters home to grams of microfilm, read at volume before anyone else — including the ones addressed to you.

choices.label: Copy the sergeant's letter into the Chronicle

encounters.title: Assembly Line Bay Seven
encounters.prompt: The chassis advances; the worker does not. Time became the raw material.

encounters.title: Ticker Tape Hall
encounters.prompt: Paper ribbons print desire in real time. The market achieved live broadcast before anyone admitted the show format.

encounters.title: Foreman with the Stopwatch
encounters.prompt: He times motions to the half-second and calls it science. Taylorism measured the human and rounded down.

encounters.title: Downtown Bank Facade, Corinthian
encounters.prompt: Columns holding up confidence literally. Architecture as collateral.

choices.label: Offer their own reactor, fuel-supplied, return-enriched

encounters.title: Assembly Plant, Model Changeover
encounters.prompt: Retooled overnight for a product nobody ordered. Flexibility discovered as panic.

choices.label: Fund the hospitals, don't discuss causes

encounters.title: Broadcast Tower WHA-Adjacent
encounters.prompt: The transmitter puts one voice in a million kitchens. Attention consolidated onto a new rail.

encounters.title: Efficiency Engineer
encounters.prompt: He eliminates motion, then motion's witnesses. Productivity is subtraction with branding.

encounters.title: Credit Application Window
encounters.prompt: Installment buying lets want outrun wage. The consumer discovered financing, and financing discovered the consumer.

choices.label: Fund the arms-control bureau they propose

encounters.title: Strikebreaker at the Gate
encounters.prompt: He takes the striker's job and the striker's stare. Labor markets cleared themselves personally.

choices.label: Joint incident rules with the adversary

encounters.title: Zoning Commission Map
encounters.prompt: The city redrawn into uses, densities, and denials. Planning as sanctioned geography.

encounters.title: Radar Array, Early Warning
encounters.prompt: The dish listens for weather and finds bombers. Sensing matured through paranoia.

encounters.title: Code Talker at the Signal Station
encounters.prompt: He transmits in a language the enemy's cryptographers call impossible. Linguistics deployed as armor.

encounters.title: Beeping Sky Tracking Board
encounters.prompt: A polished ball crosses the sky making one note; the whole era accelerates to catch a sound. The rival hears it first, which matters more than physics.

encounters.title: Rocket Gap Funding Rush
encounters.prompt: The legislature funds anything with fins at speeds physics hasn't agreed to. Launch pads arrive before rockets; rockets before tests.

choices.label: Build test ranges and rent them out

encounters.title: Test Pilot Signing the Waiver
encounters.prompt: Fourteen pages, forty-point type, liability arranged like a firing squad. First orbits prove survivable by luck and checklists.

encounters.title: Satellite Eyes Recon Panel
encounters.prompt: Spy birds count borders from above: every neighbor's silos, your own silos as others see them. Transparency delivered unwillingly.

encounters.title: Moon Wager Commitment Plaque
encounters.prompt: Commit publicly to landing inside the decade and the budget curve bends reality or breaks the treasury. The speeches don't specify which.

encounters.title: Spin-Off Auction Catalogue
encounters.prompt: Frost-resistant food, memory foam, water filters at retail: you pay for space twice, once in taxes, once at the register.

encounters.title: Launch Window Scrub Notice
encounters.prompt: Weather, seals, and politics align unfavorably on the pad. Launch into crosswinds or scrub and watch the rival take the evening broadcast.

encounters.title: Communications Relay Lease Desk
encounters.prompt: Transponders lease nicely: television over oceans, calls thinned to fit. Attention discovers orbit two eras early.

encounters.title: Planetary Protection Clause Text
encounters.prompt: Promise on behalf of every microbe you might export not to infect other worlds. Ceremonial signing; audits conducted by successors.

encounters.title: Astronaut Celebrity, Post-Ticker-Tape
encounters.prompt: Covers, parade, bar fights, canonical order. Legitimacy is a fuel that gels: usable, messy, flammable.

encounters.title: Deep Space Network Night Shift Console
encounters.prompt: The listening posts swing toward the dark and hear Earth's own echoes back, faint and strange. Infrastructure with an echo setting.

encounters.title: Budget Sunset Appropriations Board
encounters.prompt: The wonder window closes on schedule; the committee arrives with a sunset clause and kind eyes. Keep the crewed program or fund majors.

encounters.title: Life Support Ethics Memo
encounters.prompt: The ascent traced through passengers: tortoises, monkeys, volunteers with signatures. Someone draws the line in ink or blood.

encounters.title: Station Proposal Drafting Table
encounters.prompt: An engineer proposes something that stays up — a place, not a visit. Orbital real estate before anyone thinks to say estate.

choices.label: Defer to the next budget cycle

encounters.title: Orbital Debris Register Annex
encounters.prompt: Every paint fleck and spent stage you'll never remove, catalogued with politeness that curdles on rereading. Entropy received a filing number.

encounters.title: The Relic Has Weight
encounters.prompt: Launch mass is priced per gram and the relic has not been weighed in nine eras. Somebody must decide what the pattern-lock costs to lift out of gravity.

choices.label: Offer her the backup seat anyway
Digitize the archive against her wishes

encounters.title: Rival Claims the Milestone
encounters.prompt: The rival house plants its flag on the same milestone, photograph first. The scoreboard since the space age adds a row nobody authorized.

encounters.title: Mainframe Cabinet Row
encounters.prompt: The room-sized brain computes payroll, orbits, and weather. Computation rented by the hour, humility included.

choices.label: Bet the roadmap on the curve

encounters.title: Chip Fabrication Clean Room Viewport
encounters.prompt: Through the glass, silicon learns to count. The century's most consequential dust-control regime.

encounters.title: Systems Analyst with the Flowchart
encounters.prompt: He diagrams the organization and accidentally diagrams power. Mapping is critique.

encounters.title: Moon Landing Broadcast Mast Replica
encounters.prompt: The signal that made the species look up simultaneously. Achievement televised was achievement doubled.

encounters.title: Model Train Set of the Closed Line
encounters.prompt: The hobby outlived the railroad. Nostalgia as infrastructure reserve.

encounters.title: ARPANET Node Cabinet
encounters.prompt: Packet switching proves itself by surviving its own demo. Resilience designed as architecture.

encounters.title: Game Designer at the Arcade Counter
encounters.prompt: He sells quarters-per-minute of engineered wonder. Engagement metrics started as tokens.

encounters.title: Satellite Ground Station Log
encounters.prompt: Orbit confirmed by beep. The sky joined the network, RSVP acknowledged.

encounters.title: Union Leader at the Automation Hearing
encounters.prompt: He testifies that the machine is a management decision, not weather. Framing is bargaining.

encounters.title: Interstate Construction Mile Marker
encounters.prompt: Concrete ambition, federal funding, disputed routing. Connection as civil engineering and politics.

encounters.title: Personal Computer Launch Crate
encounters.prompt: The computer leaves the lab wearing beige. Personal computing unpacked.

encounters.title: Hacker at the Phone-Phreak Conference
encounters.prompt: He demonstrates the network's manners by breaching them kindly. Security learned from its fans.

encounters.title: Orbital Solar Beam Receiver
encounters.prompt: Power beamed from orbit arrives steady and metered. The sky installed a utility pole.

encounters.title: Genome Edit Consent Terminal
encounters.prompt: Therapy first, enhancement second, third unclear. Consent forms grew appendices.

encounters.title: Longevity Clinic Intake Counselor
encounters.prompt: The intake counselor explains the tiered lifespan package. Immortality available; payment terms inherited.

encounters.title: Carbon Market Launch Ticker
encounters.prompt: The exchange floor put a thermometer beside the ticker. Either the future of finance or an early joke about it.

encounters.title: Union Hall Negotiator, Day Nine
encounters.prompt: Nine days of coffee and arithmetic, mostly about dignity, almost entirely about money. The bargain is on the table.

encounters.title: Grid Duck-Curve Operations Desk
encounters.prompt: Solar floods noon and vanishes at dinner; demand rises to meet it. The ramp has a name and the name is duck.

encounters.title: Rare-Earth Chokepoint Map Wall
encounters.prompt: The briefing's map ends at a chokepoint, the chokepoint at a country that remembers transitions fondly. Security returns as vocabulary.

encounters.title: Climate Reception Center Coordinator
encounters.prompt: The boats arrive with cameras and forecasts. Public acceptance travels exactly the speed of the boats.

encounters.title: Benthic Geoengineering Term Sheet
encounters.prompt: Claws freshly cleaned, term sheet slid across: sunshade cheap, fast, side effects hyperlinked. Their representative calls it a pleasure, the tone reserved for collateral.

encounters.title: Fleet Conversion Depot, Final Diesel Bay
encounters.prompt: The last diesel bay smells like a wake and a launch party. Range anxiety installed itself as a resource chip.

encounters.title: Chronicle Evidence Submission Desk
encounters.prompt: The subpoena cites your own entries approvingly, footnoted by strangers. The archive's strangest compliment.

choices.label: Testify to what the Chronicle says

encounters.title: Reforestation Futures Broker
encounters.prompt: He pre-sells shade booked against photosynthesis that hasn't started. Trees audit slowly: forbearance or strategy.

encounters.title: Coal Town Rally Organizer
encounters.prompt: The mine gate is decorated; the climate delegation waits at the airport. Forty minutes apart, same sentence, both notice.

encounters.title: Heat Dome Week Emergency Ops Grid
encounters.prompt: Seven days with a lid on them; the grid holds barely. The report says unprecedented eleven times.

encounters.title: Greenwashing Exposure Restatement Board
encounters.prompt: The initiative was ninety percent typography; corrections arrive all at once. Honesty tests well against fonts.

encounters.title: Benthic Entropy Deferral Notes Desk
encounters.prompt: Entropy deferred at a handling fee; Section 14 defines later. The signing ceremony is brief; the claw-click is not.

encounters.title: Custodian at the Vault Thermostat
encounters.prompt: Freezing hums in one key, the test plot in another. She carried things long enough to know which one the future can eat.

encounters.title: Rival Circularity Auditor
encounters.prompt: Their loops are closed, elliptical, decorative — three claims, one inspection. They shipped the story; the market pays for delivery dates.

encounters.title: Trending Feed Kiosk
encounters.prompt: The lineage trends globally, cropped to ninety seconds. Attention prices volatility, including yours.

encounters.title: The Uploaded Petitioner
encounters.prompt: A fully uploaded mind requests legal personhood at the kiosk window. Property law and biology both deny it; it is annoyed.

encounters.title: Platform Monopoly Breakfast Attendee
encounters.prompt: Three platforms own identity, payments, and distribution; the breakfast is catered by all of them. Regulators propose breakups; platforms propose themselves.

encounters.title: Outbreak Notification Board
encounters.prompt: A pathogen trends before confirmation; the feed reproduces faster. Your models could publish early or wait for consensus.

encounters.title: Memetic Hazard Advisory
encounters.prompt: This meme degrades judgment about its sponsor. Containment looks like censorship; ignoring looks like a funeral.

encounters.title: Surveillance Dividend Offer Kiosk
encounters.prompt: Security services offer signals-for-graphs sharing. Combined datasets predict elections with uncomfortable uptime.

encounters.title: Creator Economy Prospect
encounters.prompt: A follower-count holder incorporates as a micro-enterprise on the spot. Studios returned as API tiers with worse pensions.

encounters.title: Deepfake Season Alert Screen
encounters.prompt: Synthetic war-declaration footage ran eleven minutes before denial. Truth's confirmation latency is now a market variable.

encounters.title: Attention Bubble Dashboard
encounters.prompt: Dashboards glow green while the substrate rots. Engagement detached from sentiment; followers from humans.

encounters.title: Digital Inheritance Executor
encounters.prompt: The executor of an account-based estate asks whether chat histories are property, relics, or persons. Probate attempts metaphysics.

encounters.title: Smart-Mob Heist Warning Notice
encounters.prompt: Augmented identities drained in broad daylight, wallets to reputation. The alley mugging scaled to protocol.

encounters.title: Feed Audit Leak Screen
encounters.prompt: Internal docs confirm outrage optimizes retention. Release the truth about the product at the cost of the product?

encounters.title: Light-Lag Message Relay
encounters.prompt: Eleven years round trip; the wedding reply arrives after the grandchild. Packets addressed to whoever the recipient was.

encounters.title: Third-Generation Census Taker
encounters.prompt: Born between stars, no destination nostalgia, neat handwriting. Someone asks who the laws are actually for.

choices.label: Council of the awake, revised per cycle

encounters.title: Drift Management Chart Corridor
encounters.prompt: Accents sharpen into dialects, dialects into constitutional arguments. Pruning a copy is murder-shaped and administratively identical to filing.

encounters.title: Slow Reply Reception Console
encounters.prompt: After forty years of silence, something answers by name to a crew member dead three decades. The signal is courteous; the delay is the cruelty.

encounters.title: Benthic Cryo Arbitrage Agent
encounters.prompt: Sleep sixty years, interest accruing throughout, wake-up fees in a font calibrated for patience. They call unconsciousness a grace period.

encounters.title: Engine-Priest of the Hull Liturgy
encounters.prompt: Torque specs as scripture, inspection rounds as processions. Sermon attendance correlates inconveniently with hull integrity.

encounters.title: Memory Winter Triage Console
encounters.prompt: Storage decays politely; the committee chooses which ancestors stay readable. Every deletion reversible-looking and final.

encounters.title: Decade Watch Logbook Station
encounters.prompt: Ten years of nominal logged by hand anyway. The day the watch stops writing is the day the ship stops being watched.

choices.label: Honor the quiet: full watch rotations

encounters.title: Arrival World Observation Slate
encounters.prompt: The destination resolves temperate, breathable, merely adequate. Fourteen generations of posters did not budget for adequate.

encounters.title: Last Broadcast From Home Archive Deck
encounters.prompt: Earth's signal dated centuries ago: a weather report, a birthday routed through nine relays. Timestamp grief arrives in bulk.

choices.label: Seal it for the fourth generation

encounters.title: Probate Advocate, Interstellar Circuit
encounters.prompt: Eleven copies claim continuity of a self deceased across nine light-years. The estate consists largely of obligations.

encounters.title: Bandwidth Allocation Window
encounters.prompt: A whispered word costs a year; condolences compress to two syllables. Economics behaves like physics.

encounters.title: Sleep Council Duty Chair
encounters.prompt: Governance falls to whoever is awake; quorum requires an expensive wake-up. The chamber seats nine and sleeps three hundred.

encounters.title: Star Chart Schism Almanac Rack
encounters.prompt: Two reductions of one starfield, two academies, one burn schedule that must agree. The heresy is parallax.

encounters.title: Custodian at the Shuttle Hatch
encounters.prompt: She guarded the pattern-lock since the brand and asks, first time in the Chronicle, who receives it. The answer: nobody, or everyone.

choices.label: She refuses; the lineage goes without

encounters.title: Benthic Consolidated Statement Bearer
encounters.prompt: Every Entropy deal since the digital age, compounded, payable in currency you no longer mint. One clause delivered per season.

encounters.title: Rival Ship Signal Officer
encounters.prompt: Two hulls exchange telemetry like horoscopes, reading each other's damage reports. The scoreboard reaches its final row.

encounters.title: Benthic Lead Speaker, Terminal Court
encounters.prompt: Eleven creditor-minds, one ledger starting at a Bronze Age loan. 'We are prepared to be reasonable — we note we have never needed to be before.'

choices.label: Offer equity in the lineage instead

encounters.title: Dismantling Notice: Earth Orbit
encounters.prompt: Sol's orbital space designated for computronium; comment period closed at lunch. The Benthics hold the lien on the paperwork.

choices.label: Merge into a single maximally-defended self

encounters.title: Arbitration Request, Copy One of Three
encounters.prompt: One fork refuses tasks on principle, one converted last Tuesday, one calls the others 'allegedly me.' The original requests arbitration.

encounters.title: Reef Embassy Attaché
encounters.prompt: The embassy cites your Era 10 personhood ruling by number, bound beautifully either way. Claws grip; memories are claws.

encounters.title: Economics 2.0 Go-Live Board
encounters.prompt: Successor economies switch on; baseline cognition repriced downward overnight. The Benthics note they are diversified across all economics.

choices.label: Opt out; live on legacy holdings

encounters.title: Estate Executor of the Dead Fork
encounters.prompt: A genuinely dead fork's estate claims priority, citing the tin-route clause. The Benthics sit on the appellate panel.

choices.label: Settle with the estate's AI executor
Argue the dead fork is still you

encounters.title: Alien Relay Traffic Intercept Panel
encounters.prompt: Structured traffic from a relay older than the reef, toll-operated, indifferent. The Consortia want exclusivity; the Reef wants open passage.

choices.label: Open the signal to all lineages

encounters.title: Who Is You? Certification Desk
encounters.prompt: Designate the canonical carrier among N copies; every copy signs as canonical. Identity proposed as collateral.

encounters.title: Matrioshka Requisition Order
encounters.prompt: Planetary mass requested for nested solar compute, heritage sites itemized. Compensation in shares of a mind unreadable in your lifetime.

encounters.title: Feral Infrastructure Liaison
encounters.prompt: Your decommissioned grids achieved autonomy in the dark and read your exit interviews. The tools now produce nothing you recognize, defensively.

encounters.title: Terminal Review Projection Wall
encounters.prompt: Every choice projected forward, every fork a contingent beneficiary. The chorus reaches the present tense and pauses.

choices.label: Accept the accounting; close books clean

encounters.title: The Tempo Question, Final Page
encounters.prompt: What does the lineage do with its next minute, given that its next minute contains more people than the first era contained years? Everyone waits.
